annotation.title_clean: Inter-American Guidelines on Data Governance and AI
annotation.title_en: Inter-American Guidelines on Data Governance and AI
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Department for Effective Public Management, Organization of American States (OAS)
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Working draft of OAS regional guidelines on data governance and AI, released for public consultation. Twelve themes set out commitments for member states: rights-based ethics and transparency, institutions, risk assessment, cybersecurity, open data, R&D, and multi-stakeholder cooperation. No robotics or embodied AI content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Align data and AI initiatives with the Inter-American human rights framework
Adopt risk-based measures, impact assessments and audits, with grievance and redress mechanisms
Implement UNESCO AI ethics recommendations and the UNGA March 2024 resolution
Build institutions and flexible regulation, including sandboxes and public procurement standards
Strengthen cybersecurity, vulnerability audits and AI security measures; report compliance to the OAS CAJP
